items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1972-09-13
items.q: I had him. Because he played with me a couple of times at the pool of invocation across the river.

ctx.x: That was real interesting what you were saying about Gayno.

Gayno never had a band. I was the one who knew Gayno how to play in a band. He played after me because I was probably playing this, Johnny Sensei was the first guy who showed me how to play the guitar. And then I switched from guitar to banjo. Johnny Sensei used to play with us too on the Airline Highway. In the 4900, he was on the Airline Highway. We played there. He had a little trumpet called Caledon. He said, I'll be there when you're going to get there. I said, okay. I had playing with him. I had Lawrence's…
What did he play? He played Coney. You mean the guy that was any kind of Blue? No, it wasn't a kind of Blue. No, it wasn't no kind of Blue.
